title: Customer acceptance gates and feedback telemetry playbook
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Goal: Create an operational playbook that defines customer acceptance gates (functional, performance, and security), the telemetry signals tied to each gate, and a deterministic feedback escalation flow for beta and lighthouse accounts. Scope includes: acceptance criteria templates, dashboards to surface pass/fail signals, a routing matrix for feedback items (QA, product, eng, support), and SLAs for triage/response. Out of scope: implementation of new telemetry collectors (handled by ENG tickets). This ticket coordinates the launch readiness checklist and cross-team communication plan so first lighthouse customers can be moved from pilot to paid contracts without surprises.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Documented acceptance gates for Functional, Performance (p95 latency & tokens/sec), Security (audit log presence, KMS integration), and UX readiness for beta/lighthouse accounts.
A2: Telemetry mapping that ties each gate to specific dashboard panels and alert thresholds (links to dashboards included).
A3: A feedback routing matrix that specifies owner, SLA for triage, and resolution escalation path for severity levels Sev-1..Sev-4.
A4: Run two simulated lighthouse onboarding rehearsals with internal stakeholders and capture lessons learned.
A5: Final sign-off checklist completed by PM, Eng lead, Design lead, and Customer Success for at least 3 pilot customers.
A6: Release notes coordination template created and confirmed with Communications and Legal for public/private notes.
A7: Post-launch feedback loop schedule established (7/30/90-day check-ins) and metrics to track customer health.

communication_plan: Weekly readiness sync (Wed 10am PT) - standing invite to all stakeholders
Slack channel: #beta-lighthouse-readiness - use templates for triage posts
Customer comms: two-phase email sequence (pre-onboard, go/no-go decision, onboarding plan)
Internal comms: internal changelog + short ops play distributed to SRE/Oncall
feedback_routing_matrix: Severity mapping: Sev-1 (outage) -> Eng oncall + PM + CS via paging; SLA: 1 hour
Sev-2 (critical functional regression) -> Eng triage + PM + Support; SLA: 4 hours
Sev-3 (non-blocking UX bug or performance degradation) -> Product backlog grooming; SLA: 3 business days
Sev-4 (feature request or minor nit) -> Product discovery queue; SLA: 2 sprints
telemetry_signal_map: Functional gates -> request/response error rate, schema validation failures, function-calling success rate
Performance gates -> p95 latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization on Dedicated pools
Cost gates -> tokens-per-request distribution and estimated monthly run rate for pilot accounts
Security gates -> presence of audit logs, successful KMS key rotation, RBAC enforcement logs
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Incomplete telemetry coverage leads to blindspots. Mitigation: carve out a minimal required telemetry set and instrument with highest priority; include fallback manual checks for rehearsal.
Risk: Overloaded support during early lighthouse onboarding. Mitigation: schedule onboarding waves, provide playbook w/ runbooks, and assign dedicated CS engineer for first 30 days.
Risk: Release notes leak or incorrect public copy. Mitigation: pre-approve customer-facing notes with Legal and Communications and store internal operational notes separately.
Risk: Model performance regression after rollout. Mitigation: enable automatic rollback policy and pre-configured canary traffic split for first 72 hours.
Risk: Cross-team misalignment on readiness criteria. Mitigation: require explicit sign-off from each discipline; final go/no-go meeting recorded and minutes published.
